methodsDescription: Choose how customers pay at your shop's checkout. Each method is independent.
codHint: Collect payment when the order reaches the customer.
cardHint: Customers pay through the connected payment provider.
bankTransferHint: Customers transfer to your Saudi bank account and upload a receipt for you to review.
bankNotReady: Enabled, but unavailable at checkout. Add an active Saudi account; contact support if it remains unavailable.
cardNotReady: Enabled, but the payment provider is not ready. Contact support to complete setup.
allDisabled: All payment methods are off. Customers cannot place new orders until you enable a method.
disableHint: Turning a method off stops new orders using it. Existing orders and submitted receipts can still be completed and reviewed.
accountsDescription: Customers see active accounts when bank transfer is available. Accounts receive Saudi riyals (SAR).
noAccountsHint: Use an account in your shop's name and check its IBAN before enabling bank transfer.
deleteAccountHint: Remove the account for {name} from future checkouts? Details already issued on orders and previous transfers are kept.
accountHint: Save a Saudi account that customers can transfer to. Changes apply to future checkout instructions.
saudiIbanHint: A Saudi IBAN starts with SA and contains 24 characters. Spaces are removed when saved.
accountHintFreeform: Enter the bank name and either an account number or IBAN for your store’s currency.
freeformHint: Provide an account number or IBAN (or both). Spaces in the IBAN are removed when saved.
accountOrIbanRequired: Enter an account number or IBAN.
notesHint: Customers will see these instructions. Do not enter internal notes.
bankNameRequired: Enter the name of the other Saudi bank.
holderRequired: Enter an account holder name of at least two characters.
invalidIban: Enter a valid Saudi IBAN with 24 characters.
invalidSwift: Enter a Saudi SWIFT / BIC with 8 or 11 characters, or leave it empty.
accountNumberTooLong: Use no more than 50 characters for the account number.
notesTooLong: Use no more than 500 characters for customer instructions.
invalidSort: Enter a whole number between 0 and 10000.
saveFailed: Could not save the changes. Try again.
orderPanelDescription: Review the customer's receipt on this order. Confirm the money arrived in your bank before approving.
orderWaitingHint: The customer still needs to upload transfer proof. When it arrives, check your bank account here before you approve.
checkBankBeforeApprove: Confirm the deposit in your bank before approving.
receiptFailed: Could not open this receipt. Your access may have changed; refresh and try again.
pdfHint: Download this PDF receipt to view it.
approveHint: This marks the order as paid. Confirm the money has arrived in your bank account; the uploaded receipt alone does not prove payment.
rejectHint: The customer sees your reason and can submit corrected payment evidence. This does not send a refund.
rejectionReasonHint: Write 3–500 characters. The customer will see this explanation.
reviewFailed: Could not review the transfer. Refresh to check its current status.
amountMismatch: The customer reports a different amount from the order total. Compare the actual deposit in your bank before deciding.
instructedAccount: Account originally shown to the customer
destinationDiffers: This submission names a different account from the original order instructions. Check the receiving account before approving.
